newsitem.title: UK: UK offers more time to MMC on P&O-Stena jv.
newsitem.headline: UK offers more time to MMC on P&O-Stena jv.

text.p: Britain's Board of Trade said on Friday that it would allow the Monopolies and Mergers Commission more time to report on the proposed joint venture between the Peninsular and Oriental Steam Navigation Company (P&O) and Stena Line AB.
The Department of Trade and Industry said the reporting period has been extended to April 4, 1997.
The DTI said the extension was made for "specific reasons" but did not say what they were. The MMC was due to report on the venture by March 6.
P&O and Stena signed an agreement late last year to merge their ferry businesses operating in the English Channel.
The new line -- P&O Stena Line -- announced plans to operate cross-channel routes from Dover to Calais and Zeebrugge as well as Newhaven to Dieppe. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 4366
